mod.name: Theme: Minimal Dark
mod.author: Cimm
mod.description: A complete dark, flat look for Bitwig in one mod: near-black theme colours, the Lato font, pill-shaped buttons, a highlight colour of your choice, background hue/saturation/luminance/contrast with text that stays readable, a dim behind open menus, and toolbar layout options. Doesn't need Framework: Themes.
